# BSC Shivamogga Grand Opening

> Invitation site for the BSC Shivamogga showroom grand opening on 12 October 2026 at Parekh Vinayaka Mall, BH Road, Shivamogga. Established 1938. Five-generation family fashion legacy across Davanagere, Belagavi, and Shivamogga.

## Events

- Grand Opening: Monday, 12 October 2026, 10:30 AM onwards at Parekh Vinayaka Mall, BH Road, Shivamogga
- Gala Dinner: Monday, 12 October 2026, 8:00 PM onwards at Royal Orchid, Shivamogga
- Vendor Meet: Tuesday, 13 October 2026, 10:30 AM onwards

## Contact

- Phone RSVP: +91 99000 14212 / +91 99000 14214
- WhatsApp RSVP: https://wa.me/919900014212
